    control_hist={str(k):sum(1 for d in ctl if d[1]==k) for k in range(7)},control_days_6of6=[d[0] for d in ctl if d[1]==6],

# C2-5 PRED-095 station sets

sets={'dome_table_gt80':[s for s,c in domecov.items() if c>0.80],
